text: Supreme Art
Hoeth's swordsmanship is honed to its utmost perfection in the hands of these masters, and their pitiable foes shall become mere stepping stones on their pursuit of the highest art.
Afterglow of Kingly Fire
The King's wings have bathed countless times in the radiance of the Eternal Flame; they are a people blessed by the gods.
Shield of the Queen
The Handmaidens of Avalon are the most loyal defenders of the Everqueen. They will raise the Queen's banner high upon the battlefield and fight in her name.

Death-Eye of the Heavens
Pale eyes keep watch over the land from the sky, and in an instant, the Watchers strike down Ulthuan's greatest foes.
War Cry of the Breaker
The Radiants shall serve as the vanguard of order, tearing through the enemy's lines. When their horns sound, every elf knows the hour of the attack has come.
Waterdancers
These masters unleash a storm of relentless assaults upon their enemies, striking far more frequently than other units.
Currents of Total Clarity
The Waterdancers are masters of the duel, capable of reading every subtle movement of their foes, deflecting their attacks, slipping past sturdy armor, and delivering a fatal strike.
Spreading Bloodlust

Naggarond is the bastion of elven war, and the Throne Guard have long grown accustomed to the ways of slaughter through endless strife. Some even whisper that their minds have come under the sway of the Blood God.
Champion of the Pure Mane
The Lion-Speakers are the guardians of the White Lions' homeland, and their name is a legend etched into the heart of every White Lion of Chrace.
Master of the Skies
When you gaze upon these winged creatures, you will realize that the sky belongs to them.
Pride of the Realm
Every strike of the knight quells Caledor's wrath, for the merciful dragons shall bring both punishment and rest to the enemies of the realm.
Bow of Stillness
They are called Windcallers because it is believed that their sky-blotting hail of arrows is enough to halt any storm.
